**Error log / 错误日志 (please attach! / 请务必附上!)**

Chaty records crashes and errors automatically. Open **Settings → General →
Open error log** and attach the `chaty-error.log` file (or paste its last
entries). This usually cuts diagnosis time from days to minutes.

Chaty 会自动记录崩溃与异常。打开 **设置 → 通用 → 打开错误日志**,把
`chaty-error.log` 文件附在 issue 里(或粘贴最后几条记录)——通常能把定位时间
从几天缩短到几分钟。
